```{r libraries}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
```

#Make sure the xlsx file is in the same folder as this R-file
```{r reading in data}
# This reads in the bone mineral density data collected in 3D Slicer
BMDData <- read_excel("BMDEstimation.xlsx", skip = 1)

# This removes rows with missing data
BMDData <- na.omit(BMDData)

# This breaks up the vertebrae column up by position and number
verts = as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(BMDData$Vert, ' ', 2))
BMDData$VertPos = verts$V1
BMDData$VertNum = verts$V2

# This puts the data in "front-middle-back" order instead of alphabetical order
BMDData <- mutate(BMDData, VertPos = factor(VertPos, levels=c("Front", "Middle", "Back")))

BMDData <- mutate(BMDData, Vert = factor(Vert, levels=c("Front 1","Front 2","Front 3","Front 4","Front 5", "Middle 1","Middle 2","Middle 3","Middle 4","Middle 5","Back 1","Back 2","Back 3","Back 4","Back 5")))
```

```{r summary stats}
# average BMD and summary stats for all ages and positions
summarise(BMDData, 
          n = n(),
          mean_BMD = mean(BMD, na.rm = TRUE), 
          sd_BMD = sd(BMD, na.rm = TRUE),
          se_BMD = sd_BMD / sqrt(n)
)
range(BMDData$BMD)

# Calculate the average BMD for each position
aggregate(BMDData$BMD ~ BMDData$VertPos, data = BMDData, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# sd of BMD for each position
aggregate(BMDData$BMD ~ BMDData$VertPos, data = BMDData, FUN = sd, na.rm = TRUE)

# range of BMD for each position
print(aggregate(BMDData$BMD ~ BMDData$VertPos, data = BMDData, FUN = range, na.rm = TRUE))

# Calculate the average BMD for each age class + position
aggregate(BMDData$BMD ~ BMDData$AgeClass + BMDData$VertPos, data = BMDData, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# sd of BMD for each age class + position
aggregate(BMDData$BMD ~ BMDData$AgeClass + BMDData$VertPos, data = BMDData, FUN = sd, na.rm = TRUE)

# range of BMD for each age class + position
show(aggregate(BMDData$BMD ~ BMDData$AgeClass + VertPos, data = BMDData, FUN = range, na.rm = TRUE))

# range of BMD for each age class
show(aggregate(BMDData$BMD ~ BMDData$AgeClass, data = BMDData, FUN = range, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r boxplots (Looking at position)}
ggplot(data = BMDData, aes(x = VertPos, y = BMD))+ #ggplot line
  geom_boxplot() #geometry line
  
# Boxplot by position
my_comparisons <- list( c("Front", "Middle"), c("Middle", "Back"), c("Front", "Back") )

bmdbox <- ggplot(data = BMDData, aes(x = VertPos, y = BMD, fill = VertPos))+
  geom_boxplot()+ 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#9955BB"))+ # this adds a color palette
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Front" = "Anterior", "Middle", "Back"= "Posterior"))+ # this sets your categorical labels on the x axis
  xlab("Position")+ # this sets the general x axis label
  ylab("% Hydroxyapatite")+ # this sets the y axis label
  ylim(22,72)+ # this sets the limits of the y axis
  theme_classic()+ # classic theme
  theme(legend.position="none")+ 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, label.y = c(58, 62, 66), color = "black", size = 2.5) # statistics to compare means
show(bmdbox)
ggsave("BMDBox.png", height = 4, width = 4, units = "in") # saves png to your computer in the same folder as this R script

#Boxplot by position and number
ggplot(data = BMDData, aes(x = VertPos, y = BMD, fill = VertNum))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "GnBu")

# summary stats that appear in bmdbox
compare_means(BMD ~ VertPos, data = BMDData, comparisons = my_comparisons)

desc_stats <- BMDData %>%
  group_by(VertPos) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_BMD = mean(BMD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_BMD = sd(BMD, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_BMD = sd_BMD / sqrt(n)
  )

desc_stats
```

```{r creating an lm}
# This creates a linear equation for your data 
lm_eqn <- function(y,x){
    m <- lm(y ~ x);
    eq <- substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2, 
         list(a = format(unname(coef(m)[1]), digits = 2),
              b = format(unname(coef(m)[2]), digits = 2),
             r2 = format(summary(m)$r.squared, digits = 3)))
    as.character(as.expression(eq));
}
```

```{r scatterplots (adding body length)}
# This creates data subsets by position
Front <- filter(BMDData, VertPos == "Front")
Middle <- filter(BMDData, VertPos == "Middle")
Back <- filter(BMDData, VertPos == "Back")

frontModel = lm(BMD ~ Length, data = Front)
anova(frontModel)

middleModel = lm(BMD ~ Length, data = Middle)
anova(middleModel)

backModel = lm(BMD ~ Length, data = Back)
anova(backModel)

print(lm_eqn(Front$BMD, Front$Length))

# this creates 3 scatter plots (p1, p2, p3) one for each position
p1 <- ggplot(data = Front, aes(x = Length, y = BMD))+
  geom_point(color = "#E69F00", shape=1, size = 2)+ # this sets the color, shape, and size of points
  ylim(min(BMDData$BMD), max(BMDData$BMD)+2)+ # this sets the upper and lower limit of the y-axis
  xlab("")+
  ylab("")+ # this labels your y-axis
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black")+ #this adds a trendline
  theme_classic()+ #this adds the classic theme
  geom_text(size = 3.5, x = 75, y = 72, label = lm_eqn(Front$BMD, Front$Length), parse = TRUE, color = "black") # this adds your equation to the plot 
show(p1)

p2 <- ggplot(data = Middle, aes(x = Length, y = BMD))+
  geom_point(color = "#56B4E9", shape=1, size = 2)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylim(min(BMDData$BMD), max(BMDData$BMD)+2)+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("")+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black")+
  geom_text(size = 3.5, x = 75, y = 72, label = lm_eqn(Middle$BMD, Middle$Length), parse = TRUE, color = "black")
  

p3 <- ggplot(data = Back, aes(x = Length, y = BMD))+
  geom_point(color = "#9955BB", shape=1, size = 2)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylim(min(BMDData$BMD), max(BMDData$BMD)+2)+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("")+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black")+
  geom_text(size= 3.5, x = 75, y = 72, label = lm_eqn(Back$BMD, Back$Length), parse = TRUE, color = "black")
 

# the plot_grid function allows you to put a bunch of plots together
plot_grid(bmdbox,p1,p2,p3, nrow = 4)
ggsave("BMDScatterBox.png", height = 12, width = 3, units = "in")

```

Very simple statistics
```{r ANOVAs of position and length}
# Does position and length predict BMD? (categorical x continuous)
boneModel <- lm(BMD ~ VertPos + Length, data = BMDData)
anova(boneModel)
summary(boneModel)

#Which positions are different from each-other
lengthModel1 <- pairwise.t.test(BMDData$BMD, BMDData$VertPos, p.adj = "bonf")
lengthModel1

lengthModelAnt <- lm(BMD ~ Length, data = Front)
anova(lengthModelAnt)

lengthModelMid <- lm(BMD ~ Length, data = Middle)
anova(lengthModelMid)

lengthModelPos <- lm(BMD ~ Length, data = Back)
anova(lengthModelPos)
```

```{r lms of BMD and length}
# eqn for whole column
allverts <- lm(BMDData$BMD ~ BMDData$Length)
lm_eqn(BMDData$BMD, BMDData$Length)
summary(allverts)

# lm summary anterior
summary(frontModel)

# lm summary middle
summary(middleModel)

# lm summary posterior
summary(backModel)
```
